ideas.title: Investigating Immigration and Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the intersection of immigration and fraud in Minnesota, including the Feeding Our Future fraud case and its impact on the state's political landscape.
questions: What is the extent of immigration and fraud in Minnesota?
How are these issues impacting the state's politics?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and shed light on the complex issues surrounding immigration and fraud in Minnesota. I recommend using data analysis to track the flow of money and identify potential patterns of fraud.
